itinerary.title: Visit Wagha Border & Golden Temple
itinerary.description:
• Destination: Amritsar / Kasol
• Activities and sightseeing: Attend Wagha Border Indo-Pak Historic Ceremonial Parade (if it does not take place, proceed to Jallianwala Bagh). Visit Golden Temple and explore Amritsar market.

itinerary.description:
• Starting location: Kasol
• Departure/reporting time: Reach Kasol Campsite by 11:00 AM
• Activities and sightseeing: Free time after breakfast. After lunch, hike to Chalal Village (2 Hours Hike). Evening visit to Manikarn Gurudhwara & Kasol Local Market. Group games, bonfire, and music.
• Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner
• Hotel/stay: Camping/cottage in Kasol

itinerary.title: Bijli Mahadev Trek
itinerary.description:
• Activities and sightseeing: Trek with a small backpack. 360* view of the snowclad Himalayas.
• Destination: Kullu
• Transport details: Drive to Kullu after completing trek.
• Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner
• Hotel/stay: Swiss Camp in Kullu

itinerary.title: Day for Adventure Activities: Rafting & Paragliding
itinerary.description:
• Activities and sightseeing: Early morning rope adventure activities. Highest paragliding (selfpaid) spot in manali. 8KM white water rafting (Complimentary). Visit kullu shawl factory.
• Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner
• Hotel/stay: Hotel or Cottages in Manali

itinerary.title: Solang Valley - Atal tunnel - Sissu
itinerary.description:
• Activities and sightseeing: Drive to Solang Valley & adventure activities in snow. Visit ATAL tunnel (Asia’s Longest) & explore Sissu lake. Can Rent A Bike on This Day.
• Important instructions: In Heavy Snowfall Atal tunnel & Sissu will be closed by Border Road Orginization.
• Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner
• Hotel/stay: Hotel or Cottages in Manali

itinerary.title: Manali Sightseeing & Jogini Waterfall
itinerary.description:
• Activities and sightseeing: Visit vasisth temple, Jogini Waterfall Trek. Visit Mall Road, Hadimba Temple, Old Manali.

itinerary.title: Train Journey Ahmedabad to Chandigarh
itinerary.description:
• Boarding: Sabarmati BG Railway Station / Gandhinagar Capital Railway Station
• Reporting Time: 09:00 AM
• Kickstart your adventure with an overnight train journey from Ahmedabad to Chandigarh, passing through Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Haryana. Enjoy scenic views, bond with fellow travelers through fun activities, and soak in the local flavors at stops like Abu Road and Jaipur.
• Please note that if you have a connecting train from any station in Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar to Surat, Baroda, Mumbai, or Pune, inter-station transfers are not included in our package.

itinerary.title: Drive to Shimla & day tour of Shimla
itinerary.description:
• Arrival in Chandigarh – 8:00 AM
• Reach Chandigarh Railway Station in the early morning.
• Depart for Shimla by Traveler/Taxi, enjoying the scenic drive.
• Explore Shimla’s famous Mall Road and shop for souvenirs.
• Experience the lively nightlife at Shimla’s cafés and markets.
• Stay: Hotel in Shimla

itinerary.title: Shimla to Chitkul, last village on Indo-Tibetan border
itinerary.description:
• Shimla to Chitkul – The Ultimate Road Trip
• Kickstart an adventurous morning road trip from Shimla.
• Drive through the stunning landscapes of Kinnaur Valley.
• Visit Chitkul, the last village on the old Hindustan-Tibet trade route.
• Stay: Cottage in Chitkul/Kalpa
• Food: Breakfast, Dinner Included

itinerary.title: Travel from Chitkul to Tabo, via Nako Lake
itinerary.description:
• Chitkul to Tabo – A Scenic Himalayan Drive
• Begin the journey from Chitkul, experiencing the serene village life.
• Drive along the India-Tibet border, passing through Khab, the confluence of the Spiti & Sutlej Rivers.
• Stop by the beautiful Nako Lake for a peaceful retreat.
• Stay: Homestay in Tabo
• Food: Breakfast, Dinner Included

itinerary.title: Explore Tabo and Dhankar Village
itinerary.description:
• Tabo to Kaza – Exploring Ancient Monasteries & Scenic Villages
• Visit the 1000-year-old Tabo Monastery, known for its ancient wall paintings and mud statues.
• Witness a breathtaking 360° sky view from Tabo.
• Explore Dhankar Village & Gompa, perched on a cliff with stunning valley views.
• Travel to Kaza, the headquarters of Spiti Valley.
• Stroll through Kaza Market, soaking in the local vibes.
• Stay: Homestay in Kaza
• Food: Breakfast, Dinner Included

itinerary.title: Explore Key, Komic, Langza, and Hikkim in a day
itinerary.description:
• Exploring the Wonders of Spiti Valley
• Visit Key Monastery, the largest Tibetan Buddhist monastery in Spiti, known for its murals, manuscripts, and spiritual aura.
• Explore Komic, the world’s highest motorable village (15,050 ft), and its ancient Komic Gompa.
• Witness the majestic Buddha Statue at Langza (14,300 ft) and discover fossils from an ancient seabed.
• Send a postcard from Hikkim, home to the world’s highest post office (14,400 ft).
• Stay: Homestay in Kaza
• Food: Breakfast, Dinner Included

itinerary.title: Visit Kibber and Chicham, then head towards Chandra Taal
itinerary.description:
• Spiti Valley to Chandra Taal – A Journey to the Moon Lake
• Visit Kibber, a stunning high-altitude village known for its barren beauty and monasteries.
• Cross the Chicham Bridge, the highest bridge in Asia, offering breathtaking views.
• Travel to Chandra Taal, the mesmerizing "Moon Lake" on the Samudra Tapu plateau.
• Overnight stay at Chandra Taal Camp.
• Note: Chandra Taal Lake usually opens by late May or June. If inaccessible, we stay in Kaza and reroute via Kalpa and Shimla.
• Stay: Chandratal/Losar stay in tent or Homestay
• Food: Breakfast, Dinner Included

itinerary.title: Journey to Manali through the Atal Tunnel
itinerary.description:
• Chandra Taal to Manali – A Thrilling Journey
• Start the morning with a visit to the stunning Chandra Taal Lake.
• Travel to Manali via Chhatru, experiencing one of the world’s most thrilling and scenic routes.
• Pass through the famous Atal Tunnel and explore the breathtaking Solang Valley.
• Stay: Homestay/Tent in Manali
• Food: Breakfast, Dinner Included

itinerary.title: Explore Manali & adventure activities
itinerary.description:
• Manali Adventure & Sightseeing
• Kickstart the day with thrilling adventure activities like paragliding and river rafting.
• Explore Manali’s iconic spots, including Hadimba Devi Temple, Mall Road Market, and the charming Old Manali area.
• Night drive to Jalandhar
• Food: Breakfast Included

itinerary.title: Reach Jalandhar & then board the return train
itinerary.description:
• Enjoy the overnight journey back to Ahmedabad with new friends, memories, and thrilling experiences.
• Share your photos, videos, and stories, and engage in fun activities on the way home.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Ahmedabad
itinerary.description:
• Arrival in Ahmedabad – Journey Concludes
• Enjoy the famous Rabdi & Chaat as the train passes through Rajasthan in the morning.
• Time to bid farewell, cherish the memories, and conclude this incredible journey!

itinerary.title: Ahmedabad to Cochin Train Journey
itinerary.description:
• Transport details: Comfortable overnight train journey from Ahmedabad to Kochi.
• Important instructions: Upon arrival, guests are requested to make their own arrangements for transportation from the railway station to the hotel, as transfers on this day are not included in the package.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cochin
itinerary.description:
• Departure/reporting time: Arriving at Ernakulam Junction around 9:00 PM.
• Important instructions: Proceed to your hotel near the railway station and settle in after your long train journey. Take the evening to relax and recharge, as no sightseeing is scheduled today.
• Hotel/stay: Hotel in Cochin

itinerary.title: Scenic Drive to Munnar
itinerary.description:
• Transport details: Warm pick-up from your respective Hotel. Breathtaking drive to Munnar through lush green hills and misty landscapes.
• Activities and sightseeing: Witness the beauty of the stunning Valara & Cheeyappara Waterfalls and explore aromatic Spice Plantations, where Kerala’s famous spices are grown.
• Meals: Breakfast & Dinner Included
• Hotel/stay: Hotel in Munnar

itinerary.title: Explore the Beauty of Munnar
itinerary.description:
• Activities and sightseeing: Explore the scenic highlights of Munnar, including the peaceful Mattupetty Dam, the magical Echo Point, and the picturesque Kundala Dam. Visit the famous Eravikulam National Park (subject to government guidelines). Also explore the vibrant Rose Garden and enjoy some free time for local shopping and café hopping.
• Meals: Breakfast & Dinner Included
• Hotel/stay: Hotel in Munnar

itinerary.title: Thekkady – Wildlife & Cultural Experience
itinerary.description:
• Departure/reporting time: Check out by 8:00 AM.
• Transport details: Scenic drive to Thekkady.
• Activities and sightseeing: Afternoon experience the peaceful Periyar Lake cruise (optional, direct payment). Enjoy an elephant interaction experience at Periyar. Evening witness Kerala’s rich traditions with the mesmerizing Kalaripayattu martial arts and Kathakali cultural show.
• Meals: Breakfast & Dinner Included
• Hotel/stay: Hotel stay in Thekkady

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey – Backwater Paradise
itinerary.description:
• Transport details: Proceed to Alleppey, known as the “Venice of the East.”
• Activities and sightseeing: Experience the beauty of Kerala’s famous backwaters with an optional boat ride (direct payment). Cruise through peaceful canals.
• Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner Included
• Hotel/stay: Hotel/Houseboat Alleppey
• Important instructions: For stay in Alleppey House Boat AC timing will be from 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM.

itinerary.title: Alleppey to Cochin
itinerary.description:
• Transport details: Scenic drive back to Kochi.
• Activities and sightseeing: Explore the charming streets of Fort Kochi, admire the iconic Chinese Fishing Nets, and enjoy some free time for local shopping if time permits.
• Meals: Breakfast Included
• Hotel/stay: Hotel in Cochin

itinerary.title: Cochin to Ahmedabad
itinerary.description:
• Transport details: Proceed to Ernakulam Railway Station to board your train to Ahmedabad.
• Important instructions: Transportation from the railway station to the hotel is not included and should be arranged by the participants.
• Meals: Breakfast Included. Dinner on this day is also self-paid.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Ahmedabad
itinerary.description:
• Destination: Ahmedabad
• Activities and sightseeing: Arrive back in Ahmedabad with countless memories, new friendships, and amazing experiences to cherish forever.
